name: Natural Kare and Wellness, LLC.
blurb: Natural Kare & Wellness provides personalized nutrition and wellness coaching to help women make healthier, sustainable lifestyle changes — without fad diets or guilt. Led by Natasha Muir-Kennedy, MS, a nutrition and wellness consultant with a Master's in Applied Clinical Nutrition, a Bachelor's in Health Education & Health Promotion, and more than 15 years of experience in healthcare, the practice specializes in emotional eating, healthy weight management, gut health and digestive wellness, and menopause and perimenopause nutrition. Sessions are practical and supportive, built around whole foods and realistic habits that fit your life. All sessions are by telehealth, so you can work with Natasha from wherever you are. Host of the Natural Kare podcast, available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, YouTube, Amazon Music, and iHeartRadio.
